(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a __lower__ base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the __lower__ base member.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body and are arranged to form a pattern that differs from that shown in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes, such that the arrangement provides enhanced thermal performance compared to arrangements known in the prior art.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body, with the arrangement of diodes differing from that in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, configured to enhance heat dissipation beyond that disclosed in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The lamp of claim 1 including a single optic element that is disposed between each adjacent fin, overlapping said diode in a manner that enhances the light output compared to structures described in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and is arranged to provide a unique configuration that differs fundamentally from that shown in Chang.
